title: Data Scientist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Data Scientist who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving

Structure complex problems methodically

Modeling techniques, and experimental validation to deliver results

Communication Skills: capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

CI/CD pipelines

AWS

Big Data (Spark, cloud storage, Big Query, etc.)

Designs robust, scalable APIs, handles auth & versioning

Extracting insights from data to support business decisions.

Data wrangling

Statistical analysis

Design ML systems, evaluate trade-offs

Leads innovation with GenAI, custom model development

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles

  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.


What you will do :

  • Develop responsive and elegant web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and improve data flow.
  • Translate design mockups into reusable and scalable components.
  • Continuously optimize applications for performance and accessibility.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and a great user experience on all devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to the team’s technical growth.


What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Dentista clínico geral
description:
Descrição da Empresa Faça parte da equipe Cia do Sorriso

Buscamos profissionais comprometidos, éticos e com foco em resultados para atuar em uma clínica moderna, com fluxo de pacientes e estrutura completa.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Dentista Clínico Geral para se juntar à nossa equipe na. As responsabilidades desse cargo incluem realizar consultas e procedimentos clínicos odontológicos, diagnósticos, tratamentos preventivos e curativos, além de orientações para cuidados com a saúde bucal. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Consultas e Procedimentos Clínicos: É essencial realizar consultas, diagnósticos e tratamentos odontológicos diversos, clínico geral, endodontia e prótese.
  • Prevenção e Cuidados: Necessário possuir conhecimentos em tratamentos preventivos e medidas de cuidado contínuo para a saúde bucal dos pacientes.
  • Comunicação e Orientação: Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para orientar pacientes sobre higiene oral e cuidados pós-tratamento.

title: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!




Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado



A Divisão de IBOPE Mídia está contratando Analista de P&D para desenvolver sistemas embarcados para trabalho em projetos de Audiência de TV.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de software embarcado para plataforma global de medição de audiência.
  • Manter tecnologias existentes, implementando novas soluções e/ou adaptando as existentes de acordo com as necessidades do produto.




O que buscamos?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para ambiente Android, utilizando linguagem Java.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Bom conhecimento de linguagem Java.
  • Conhecimento de Android embarcado, a partir da versão 9.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Noções de Node.JS.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de banco de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX é considerado um plus.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, sob metodologia ágil.
  • Desejável ser um usuário intermediário/avançado de Linux.


Idioma: Fundamental Inglês avançado para uso diário.





O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Frontend - Sênior
description:
Esperamos que você:

  • Traduza necessidades de produto e design em entregas técnicas escaláveis e bem estruturadas;
  • Garanta excelência técnica nos componentes, fluxos de publicação e documentação, mantendo alta qualidade, performance e usabilidade;
  • Promova cultura de boas práticas de engenharia, acessibilidade e inner-source.


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar com migração da stack de CSS-in-JS, otimização de performance e SSR, manutenção e organização de monorepo, estruturação de bundling, CI/CD e publicação de pacotes;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com pessoas de Produto, Design, Dados e Engenharia, promovendo alinhamento e entregas integradas;
  • Contribuir para uma documentação clara, acessível e de fácil uso por outros squads.


Requisitos

  • Proficiência com TypeScript e React;
  • Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);
  • Vivência com monorepos (ex: Lerna, Nx, Turborepo);
  • Experiência com testes unitários e end-to-end;
  • Conhecimento em acessibilidade Web (padrões WCAG).


Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Experiência em atuar com Design System e Design Tokens;
  • Vivência em migração de ferramentas CSS-in-JS;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, Chromatic);
  • Implementação e manutenção de Storybook;
  • Testes de regressão visual;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou iniciativas internas de melhoria contínua.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente desafiador com impacto real em produtos utilizados por milhões de pessoas;
  • Colaboração direta com designers, devs e líderes técnicos altamente capacitados;
  • Cultura de engenharia baseada em aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e excelência.


Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

title: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!




Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado



A Divisão de IBOPE Mídia está contratando Analista de P&D para desenvolver sistemas embarcados para trabalho em projetos de Audiência de TV.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de software embarcado para plataforma global de medição de audiência.
  • Manter tecnologias existentes, implementando novas soluções e/ou adaptando as existentes de acordo com as necessidades do produto.




O que buscamos?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para ambiente Android, utilizando linguagem Java.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Bom conhecimento de linguagem Java.
  • Conhecimento de Android embarcado, a partir da versão 9.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Noções de Node.JS.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de banco de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX é considerado um plus.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, sob metodologia ágil.
  • Desejável ser um usuário intermediário/avançado de Linux.


Idioma: Fundamental Inglês avançado para uso diário.





O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

description:

Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline

  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.

Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering

  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!




Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado



A Divisão de IBOPE Mídia está contratando Analista de P&D para desenvolver sistemas embarcados para trabalho em projetos de Audiência de TV.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de software embarcado para plataforma global de medição de audiência.
  • Manter tecnologias existentes, implementando novas soluções e/ou adaptando as existentes de acordo com as necessidades do produto.




O que buscamos?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para ambiente Android, utilizando linguagem Java.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Bom conhecimento de linguagem Java.
  • Conhecimento de Android embarcado, a partir da versão 9.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Noções de Node.JS.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de banco de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX é considerado um plus.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, sob metodologia ágil.
  • Desejável ser um usuário intermediário/avançado de Linux.


Idioma: Fundamental Inglês avançado para uso diário.





O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!




Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado



A Divisão de IBOPE Mídia está contratando Analista de P&D para desenvolver sistemas embarcados para trabalho em projetos de Audiência de TV.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de software embarcado para plataforma global de medição de audiência.
  • Manter tecnologias existentes, implementando novas soluções e/ou adaptando as existentes de acordo com as necessidades do produto.




O que buscamos?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para ambiente Android, utilizando linguagem Java.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Bom conhecimento de linguagem Java.
  • Conhecimento de Android embarcado, a partir da versão 9.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Noções de Node.JS.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de banco de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX é considerado um plus.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, sob metodologia ágil.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!
